messages:
maria: Quick idea — propose a temporary 'compare session' in Console for rollout QA. Open a lightweight side-by-side of two model variants across selected routes, show a quota/cost preview and routing hints. Looking for API/telemetry/UX concerns.
aj: Nice. Do we mean a saved query under the hood or purely ephemeral? main risk is accidental persistence and costing people. :eyes: 
maria: Ephemeral by default (TTL 1h), but with an explicit "save as" button that converts to regular saved query. Backend should tag telemetry with compare_session_id so it doesn't trigger eval/alert rules.
sam: telemetry questions: if we route the same traffic twice to compare models we could double count usage. Can we simulate expected unit cost instead of duplicating live traffic?
maria: Good point. Two options: 1) simulated dry-run cost estimate based on sample token distributions and model perf profiles; 2) live A/B with explicit opt-in that clearly shows doubled cost and increments quota usage. Default to option 1.
jeff: For the API, simplest surface is a POST that returns a session_id and cost_estimate. Something like:
```
POST /api/console/compare_sessions
{
  "routes": ["/api/search","/api/autocomplete"],
  "models": ["redwood/gpt-2.9b","redwood/gpt-2.9b-quant"],
  "mode": "simulated", // simulated | live-ab
  "window": "15m"
}
```
Response: { session_id, ttl_seconds, cost_estimate_usd, telemetry_tag }

violet: UX: show quota impact inline in the header + a small tooltip explaining simulated vs live-ab. Also show per-route delta and expected latency changes. If simulated, show confidence bands.
aj: How do we surface routing hints? If a route has traffic pinning (customer routing policy) we should warn the user that their compare session won't mirror production unless they include that policy.
maria: Agree. Add a routing-hints panel that fetches a route's active routing policies and highlights mismatches, with a checkbox to apply policies to the session.
sam: Telemetry: we'll need to add a compare_session flag to the event schema and exclude those from SLA/alert calculations by default. Also add an annotation to sampled traces. This is low-risk.
jeff: Backend implications: session objects live in Console DB with ttl index. When mode=simulated we run a cost estimator service (uses model token profile + historical route token distribution) and return numbers. If mode=live-ab we create a routing token to route a portion of traffic to secondary model — needs quota checks and a surge guard.
product-bot: Deploy note: compare_sessions API is gated behind feature-flag 'console.compare_sessions' and will roll out to 50% of orgs initially.
violet: UI microcopy: "QuickCompare (ephemeral) — saves are manual. Simulated estimates do not consume quota. Live AB will consume quota and should be scheduled off-peak"
aj: One edge: savedquery conversion. If user "saves" an ephemeral session, we should snapshot the sampling parameters (route selection, window, model versions) and mark it as created_by=owner, not ephemeral. Also need ACL checks.
maria: Action items: 
- @sam: add compare_session flag to telemetry schema + exclude rules (owner: Observability)
- @jeff: draft API contract + cost estimator interface
- @violet: mocks for compare header, routing-hints panel, save flow
- @aj: spec for savedquery conversion + ACL + quota UX copy
I'll sync w/ infra on feature flag rollout after initial designs.
sam: ack, will prototype telemetry changes this week.
jeff: I'll put a strawman API doc in the product RFC repo and link here.
violet: I'll drop mocks in product Figma and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks all — sounds like consensus on ephemeral-first plus explicit live-ab opt-in. We'll aim for internal beta behind flag.
